{"Topic": "Purpose", "Details": "Synthetic 90-day dataset for a C30 demand-forecasting and inventory / raw-material procurement prototype."}
{"Topic": "Historical date range", "Details": "2026-07-20 through 2026-10-17 inclusive (90 days). Forecast horizon: 2026-10-18 through 2026-10-24."}
{"Topic": "Locations", "Details": "Four illustrative locations: two cafés (CAFE01/CAFE02) and two grocery shops (GROC01/GROC02). Names are invented."}
{"Topic": "Products", "Details": "Five café prepared-food items per café and five grocery SKUs per grocery shop."}

{"Topic": "Data status", "Details": "All store names, footfall, sales, stock movements, ingredient usage, batch records and purchase orders in this workbook are synthetic. They are NOT actual business records."}

{"Topic": "Demand vs. sales", "Details": "Estimated_Demand_Units is latent simulated customer demand. Units_Sold is capped by eligible stock. Lost_Demand_Units = demand minus sales, to represent potential lost sales. Real stores generally need to estimate lost demand during stockouts."}
{"Topic": "Footfall", "Details": "Footfall_Visits is illustrative customer visits per location per day. Transactions_or_Bills is a simulated count of transactions / bills."}

{"Topic": "Cafe stock input/output", "Details": "Cafe Stock_Input_Units means prepared/production input of the finished menu item. For cafes, raw material consumption is derived from Units_Sold × Cafe_Recipe_BOM."}
{"Topic": "Grocery stock input/output", "Details": "Grocery Stock_Input_Units means supplier deliveries of the SKU. Stock_Output_Units equals units sold plus waste/expired/damaged write-offs."}
{"Topic": "Inventory balance", "Details": "For each product-day: Opening_Stock + Stock_Input = Stock_Output + Closing_Stock. Waste is included in stock output and is separate from sold units."}

{"Topic": "Café recipe / BOM", "Details": "Recipes and portion quantities are illustrative assumptions, not recipes observed from a real café. Confirm recipes, yield loss, packaging and prep yield before using operationally."}

{"Topic": "Demand forecast", "Details": "Next seven days use the average of up to four previous observations with the same weekday. Lower/upper values are indicative spread bands, not a validated prediction interval."}

{"Topic": "Raw material buying", "Details": "Material requirement forecast = product demand forecast × recipe quantities. Buy quantities cover supplier lead time + a 7-day review period + 2-day safety stock, minus on-hand and open PO quantity; order rounded to pack size / MOQ."}
{"Topic": "Grocery restock", "Details": "Grocery restock uses estimated demand from the same-weekday baseline and considers lead time, 2-day safety stock, on-hand, open POs, pack size and MOQ."}

{"Topic": "Purchase recommendations", "Details": "Recommendations are decision support only. They do NOT place orders. Human confirmation is needed for physical counts, approved suppliers, budget, shelf life, cold chain, pack sizes and delivery timing."}
{"Topic": "Expiry rules", "Details": "Expired batches are blocked from sale in the dataset logic. Near-expiry items are surfaced for supervisor review; never discount an expired or unsafe product."}

{"Topic": "Model evaluation", "Details": "Forecast_Backtest_* evaluates a simple same-weekday forecast on the last 14 days using synthetic estimated demand. It is not a real-world accuracy benchmark."}
{"Topic": "Economics", "Details": "Unit contribution = sales revenue less item-level unit cost only. It excludes labour, rent, electricity, delivery, platform fees, taxes and other operating costs."}

{"Topic": "Use in assignment", "Details": "Label the workbook as a synthetic prototype. Do not claim observed customer demand, real revenue reduction, actual waste reduction or a completed customer pilot."}
{"Topic": "Suggested next step", "Details": "Replace illustrative inputs with the official C30 fixture and consented, anonymised store data; run the same workflow as a supervised pilot."}
